description: Query enterprise business registration data for corporate due diligence.

display.description_en: Query enterprise business registration data, support fuzzy enterprise search, company basic information, beneficial owners, shareholders, actual controllers, industrial-commercial changes, contact information, key personnel, branches, external investments, annual reports, listed-company related information and other enterprise due-diligence scenarios.
